description: Heromancer is an idle RPG on Solana. Your hero NFTs (star-rated ★1-★5) battle 24/7 - claim their loot, sell it for $HMANCER, gear up, summon new heroes, and level up your account MMO-style. Heroes are playable in-game and tradable player-to-player. Registration is $1 and mints your ★★★ Genesis Hero. Your heroes fight while you sleep.
name: Heromancer
